reports.title: Redtail Cryptominer Deployment Captured
reports.summary: Captured a live Redtail cryptominer deployment from IP 130.12.180.51. Full attack chain recovered including cleanup scripts, multi-architecture binaries, and SSH persistence backdoor.

reports.title: Outlaw IRC Botnet — Still Active in 2026
reports.summary: 72 unique IPs deployed the mdrfckr SSH backdoor key in a single day. The Outlaw cybergang has been using the identical key since 2020. IRC-based botnet deploying XMRig Monero miner disguised as kswapd0.
